title: GM Opinions
description: teams/<slug>/opinions.json — this GM's seeded preseason opinion of every OTHER character (the 11 other GMs, plus 'commissioner' and 'media'), formed at /gms-meeting from public personas only. Keyed by counterpart slug. Joins the GM's own R1 dossier as priors; rewritable under GM-file governance (max 3 edits/season, note windows only, logged in state/rulings.md).

stance.description: The working relationship going into the season.

take.description: One in-character sentence — quotable, will surface in forum posts and trade messages all season.

hooks.description: At least one MECHANICAL relationship rule (a vibe without a mechanic is decoration), e.g. 'never accept X's first offer', 'believes everything the tabloid prints about Y', 'checks Z's forum post before setting a lineup'.
